scope: Sanitized recorded measurements for memory-constrained large models and retained distributed-engine changes. No raw requests, replies or device logs.

qwen.variant: Native MTP head preserved; no separate draft model

rate_convention: Sum emitted tokens times 1000 divided by summed native generation milliseconds. One token per request belongs to prompt processing; an adjusted rate is also supplied. Startup, warmup, prompt processing and explicit cooling waits are excluded from generation time.
identity_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON [returned content, returned reasoning], with absent/null text normalized to an empty string. Finish reason and emitted-token count are compared separately. No claim about unobserved tensors or arbitrary requests.

lfm_capacity.counter_scope: System-wide, unequal measurement windows; not exclusive process I/O.
lfm_capacity.limit: Practical memory/placement comparison, not a globally optimal Mac-only result or isolated GPU/kernel scaling.

fusion_submission.control: Experimental settings off in LlamaPad integration; not an unrestricted stock llama.cpp baseline.
fusion_submission.limit: Combined two-GPU comparison; does not isolate each flag or establish standalone per-device gains. System paging occurred.

canonical_replay.limit: Coordinator change, not an iPad kernel/driver change. Editing-dependent gain; fresh chat regresses 1.53%. Footprint excludes reclaimable mapped model pages. No free-RAM guarantee.

mac_only.reason: Sustained warning-level memory pressure during startup.

qwen_capacity_mtp.limit: No completed Mac-only rate or Mac-to-RPC ratio. Nominal starts do not hold physical temperature constant; MTP gain includes thermal effects. Upstream native MTP, not a new LlamaPad algorithm.

not_measured: Separate standalone Mac-only and iPad-only code speedups
